latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ElevenLabs integration via ClawLink

- Adds support for managing voices, speech assets, audio projects, and voice workflow tasks in ElevenLabs from chat.
- Uses ClawLink as a secure, hosted integration hub—no manual ElevenLabs API configuration required.
- Provides step-by-step setup guidance for installing ClawLink, pairing devices, and connecting ElevenLabs accounts.
- Dynamically discovers and uses available ElevenLabs tools based on connected account and live tool catalog.
- Enforces safety rules; confirmation required for destructive or external write actions.
- Comprehensive instructions and resource links included for easy onboarding.
